description: FRED's own compatibility record. Researched baseline facts are kept separate from executed evidence. Schema: docs/architecture.md#compatibilityjson.

target.consequence: Board revision only matters for electrical/pin guidance; such guidance stays unresolved (C-GPIO-001).

api.notes: Version row re-read during implementation; table parsed by scripts/compare_api.py with no malformed or duplicate rows (3537 Function, 311 Variable, 319 Header rows).

sdk_artifact.consequence: SDK identity is index metadata only. During implementation the index host was not reachable from the build session (egress proxy refused update.flipperzero.one), so bytes remain unverified (issue #7).

ufbt_bootstrap.notes: Bootstrap alone does not pin the build: the SDK carries much of the build machinery, and first run defaults to the moving release channel.

toolchain.consequence: No compiled-support claim is possible until a trusted toolchain is installed under isolated UFBT_HOME and its versions recorded (issue #7).

observed_non_baseline.notes: 42 added exports, no removals or signature changes relative to 1.5.1 (C-BASE-005). Informational only.

documentation_reviewed.reason: Official docs and selected third-party docs reviewed within the scope stated in the research record.

source_inspected.reason: Pinned firmware, uFBT and catalog sources inspected; every registry source URL re-resolved at its pin on 2026-10-16.

static_checks.reason: ufbt lint for benchmark fixtures needs the SDK/toolchain, which is not installed and could not be fetched in this session.

compiled.reason: No prepared trusted toolchain; SDK download host unreachable from the session; installation not authorized (issue #7).

host_tests.reason: Benchmark fixtures define inputs and corpora; reference host tests for fixture logic are part of SDK qualification (issue #7). FRED's own helper tests are recorded separately in docs/evaluation.md.

device_behavior.reason: No hardware access or authorization; requires issue #9.

surfaces.notes: Implementation guidance traced to pinned source; not compiled or device-tested.
